notes: I1: the paper reports its own gas-phase H2 isotherms (Fig. 5, wt% vs 0-90 bar at 77 K, three C60-Se composites) but never names the measurement method or instrument (gravimetric vs volumetric is unstated); judged met because the values are measured gas-phase uptake, not computed, TPD-only or electrochemical. I2: sorbents are C60-Se composites (carbon composite class). Section 2.2 (p. 2) uses 0.1 g C60 with 0.1 g sodium selenite pentahydrate (about 0.03 g Se) for the 1:1 composite, and the 2:1 and 3:1 composites contain more fullerene, so carbon is the majority by mass for at least the 2:1 composite under any reading of the ratio (mass of salt, mass of Se, or moles). The phrase 'the composite containing 3 wt% of fullerene' (p. 5) is read as the 3:1 composite. No surface area is reported for any sample (characterization is XRD, SEM, TEM only), so the first applicable exclusion code is no_surface_area. Not a review; no retraction notice (record is_retracted false); no statement that the uptake data were published before.
